title: Bending Spoons' Nasdaq IPO caps its 50+ deals across 10+ years that transformed the Italian startup into a highly leveraged internet company with ~$4.4B in debt (Financial Times)
commentary: A European app rollup with $4.4B in debt goes public on Nasdaq — Bending Spoons built an empire by acquiring distressed apps and squeezing them, and now Wall Street gets to decide if that's a business model or a liability stack wearing a growth story.
